text: Assumption: Callers shall prevent parallel or interrupting calls themselves — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: Callers shall prevent parallel or interrupting calls themselves — is this correct?
norm: callers shall prevent parallel or interrupting calls themselves
assumption: Callers shall prevent parallel or interrupting calls themselves.
rationale: The element is specified as Non Reentrant, without the payload naming concrete synchronization mechanisms.
